answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 39347 Country: Pakistan Title: My wife has been having dreams twice about getting married to different people and twice about getting proposal from a cousin and later she saw the cousin trying to show that she is her property Question: My wife has been having dreams twice about getting married to different people and twice about getting proposal from a cousin and later she saw the cousin trying to show that she is her property. Me and my wife are in nikah right now, rukhsati is not yet done. We try to follow Islam as much as possible. We love each other a lot, we do not want to live without each other. We both are worried. Please tell us what these dreams mean? Answer ID: 39347 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1025/719/D=1433) The dream indicates that the family of your wife shall get virtues and wealth from somewhere. One should trust in Allah, He is the only Giver and Forbidder. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
